title: Changes and Cancellations of Wanderlane Traveller Club Award Bookings
content:
An award booking made with Wanderlane Traveller Club points may be changed against the tier's award change fee and cancelled against its award cancel fee, and on cancellation the points return to the card carrying their original expiry.

## What the determination settles

1. **A change is charged at the award change fee of the tier**, and the booking continues as a booking made with points.
2. **A cancellation is charged at the award cancel fee of the tier**, which is a separate figure from the change fee.
3. **The points come back as they went out.** On cancellation the points return to the card carrying their original expiry: they do not take a fresh expiry date from the day of the cancellation, and the time they spent committed to the booking does not extend them.

## The two fees distinguished

| What the member asks for | The fee read | What happens to the points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The award booking is changed | The award change fee of the tier | The points stay committed to the booking |
| The award booking is cancelled | The award cancel fee of the tier | The points return to the card carrying their original expiry |

In a hypothetical case, points credited to a card in April of one year and committed to an award booking in September of the same year come back on a cancellation in December still carrying the expiry they had when they were credited in April.
